_what: The ratchet ceiling for bed_pixels: how much of our own mattress the frame is allowed to show before the build fails. NOT the target - see best_on_record and target below.
_why_a_ratchet: A flat cut at the delivered value fails 15 of 15 masked frames in this lane history, because the bare flank is in every frame this studio has made. A rung red on every render gets switched off (R13). So the absolute number PRINTS on every run into the render path and what BLOCKS is the number rising - which is the half nothing caught when it rose 23x between p2r31e and p2r44 while coverage read 94.0% and fall_sides read 4/4.
_how_to_lower_it: A round that covers more of the mattress re-runs bed_pixels and writes the lower numbers here, naming the round. It may only ever go DOWN. Raising it is a decision that needs a row in qa/open-decisions.json saying why the bed is allowed to get worse.

best_on_record.note: p2r54, the D-109 interim integration: fused-body count, first of its semantics. Not comparable to the separable numbers below (D-111).

separable.note: p2r52, the D-106 whole-bed integration: the bought bed brings its own mattress and bedding, so the defect's surface area fell 99.4% by construction (254,849 -> 1,459 flank px), not by drape tuning. The previous record was the HAND-BUILT cloth stack (p2r31e, 11,694 px) — kept here as history and as the proof it was never an instruction to revert: his class order stands (R13, D-104) and the bought bed now beats the hand-built record 8x on the same camera.

target.note: three blind sighted readers over 7 delivered frames: 16 of 18 legible readings none, 2 sliver, 0 above sliver; ours most 3 for 3. The panel answers on a word scale and delivered frames carry no object mask, so no delivered flank can be counted in pixels - this target is a direction with a fact behind it, not a measured px value.

_rebaselined_p2r54: D-111: fused-body semantics (81d895fd models frame+mattress as one shell; every exposed body pixel counts as core — stricter than the separable count by construction). The ratchet's own semantics guard refused the cross-construction comparison; this baseline is the deliberate restart. The separable-era numbers stay in best_on_record.separable below for the day a separable bed returns. The shell wears the signed D3-1 base linen (value 114), so what shows reads as dark base, the delivered grammar; the cross-construction judge is the blind panel, run on this frame this round.
_rebaselined_p2r91: D-181: the camera of record moved to B (D-175, HIS answer 'B') and the whole-bed acquisition (D-106) returned separable semantics, so BOTH ratchet guards refuse the p2r54 fused-body/old-camera numbers by name — this is the deliberate restart the rung asks for, not a raising. 17,690 px core at 5.0% of a 355,398 px sleeping surface, measured on the first full frame with the key sun. core_flank/core_top are null because the flank/top projection does not reproduce this mask on camera B (printed 'SPLIT NOT AVAILABLE' with the two witness rows) — the ratchet's own None-skip covers them until the projection is fixed; core_px is the row that holds.
